itemdesc-sparker: Pocketable ignition device. “Only you can prevent peat fires.”
itemdesc-illuminant: Constantly provides a soft glow without heat. “Light must come from inside. You cannot ask the darkness to leave; you must turn on the light.”
blockdesc-glowstick-basic-lit-*: Provides a constant light without heat. This glowstick is lambent, but will dim over time. “A torch for when any kind of flame is far too risky.”
blockdesc-glowstick-basic-dim-*: Provides a dim light without heat. This glowstick has dimmed, but it can be reluminated. Pick it up & re-adjust it with your wrench. “A torch for when any kind of flame is far too risky.”
blockdesc-flashbulb: Can be deployed for brilliant luminence. “Light must come from inside. You cannot ask the darkness to leave; you must turn on the light.”
itemdesc-wrench: Multitool prized by tinkerers. Wrench, SolderingIron, & CanOpener. “The best investment is in the tools of one's own trade.”
itemdesc-solderingiron: A curious design of soldering iron. Can be used to draw geometric designs on metal. “The best investment is in the tools of one's own trade.”
itemdesc-cogblade: Restored form of a previous age. “It's dangerous to go alone.”
itemdesc-spear-improved-hacking: Attack a locust for a chance to convert it into an ally. It will follow and protect you, but you can only maintain one converted locust at a time. A refined design of practicality, for the distinguished clockmaker. Bring the wayward children home.
itemdesc-spear-starlight-hacking: Attack a locust for a chance to convert it into an ally. It will follow and protect you, but you can only maintain one converted locust at a time. A brilliant design of luminosity, for the stargazing chronologer. Let the light show them the way.
itemdesc-spear-master-hacking: Attack a locust for a chance to convert it into an ally. It will follow and protect you, but you can only maintain one converted locust at a time. A masterpiece of temporal engineering, for the perfectionist tinkerer. Instill them with new purpose.
itemdesc-spear-bigfork-hacking: Attack a locust for a chance to convert it into an ally. It will follow and protect you, but you can only maintain one converted locust at a time. An aggressive design of determination, for the foolhardy adventurer. End the poor things' needless suffering.
itemdesc-clothes-face-goggles00: Optic-filtering multifocal goggles. “Sustained wear may cause sever eye strain.”
itemdesc-clothes-face-goggles01: Mechanically adjustable telescopic goggles. “Sustained wear may cause sever eye strain.”
itemdesc-clothes-face-goggles02: Personal Protective Equipment. “Safety glasses on!”
itemdesc-clothes-face-goggles03: Personal Protective Equipment. “Safety glasses on!”
itemdesc-flicker-*: Advanced ignition device. “Only you can prevent peat fires.”
blockdesc-*storagevessel*: Advanced technological storage container. Preservation through spatial compression. “It's bigger on the inside!?”
